title: 第18章 这事误会大了！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 唐逸，你大爷，你给老子等着！”梁绍破口大骂，挣脱唐逸转身就逃。“少爷！”“我草，发生了什么？为什么这群人都追着少爷？”一群护卫还在殴打蜷缩在地上的乞丐，看到整条街的人都在追自家少爷，瞬间全都懵逼了。诗仙？少爷字都认不全，怎么就成诗仙了？“诗仙，你别跑，给我赋诗一首！”唐逸也在追。他其实不想追的，梁绍开口叫出他名字的时候，他就知道是自己误会了。但唐音在梁绍的前方撒丫子狂奔，逼得他不得不跟着追过去，不然这妮子被人群冲散，后果不堪设想。这事闹得……误会大了啊！而且从前身的记忆中，他知道梁绍和前身是好友，只是母亲过世后颜霜玉上位，想要扶持唐画而杜绝他和梁绍等人见面。这也就导致唐逸和梁绍已经有差不多四年的时间没见了。当时青涩的少年如今已经长开，两人也没有第一时间认出彼此，这才有了误会！“你们特妈别追了，老子不是诗仙，老子是诗仙他祖宗！”梁绍怒吼！看到身后跟着黑压压的一群人，他差点都吓尿了，把吃奶的劲都使了出来。“你不是诗仙，你跑什么？！”有人怒吼。“你们特妈不追我，我能跑吗？”梁绍直接回怼。“别听他胡说，他就是诗仙，前方的小孩就是证据。”有人直接指着唐音大声说道。果然见到唐音，众人都更加激动了，没错，是诗仙无疑了。当日诗仙就是带着个孩子，一起摆摊卖诗的。啪！唐逸抬手捂脸，兄弟，不是我不解释，现在是根本解释不清了啊！坏哥哥，你要害死音儿了……唐音跑在最前方，这时大眼睛中都是泪。她这小短腿，怎么可能跑得过大人的大长腿嘛！好在跑过半条街，她看到了一条细小的巷子，直接就蹿了进去。梁绍不知道她的身份，自然只能往前狂奔，一群人也从巷口外追了过去。而哥哥的身影，也出现在了巷口，正双手撑着膝盖，假装大口大口喘气。“哥，那是梁家哥哥，他……他不会有事吧？”唐音认识梁绍的，之前哥哥被禁足，梁绍带着人来找过哥哥几次。还给她带来了好多好吃的，但都被二哥抢了。“应该，可能，大概，也许……不会有事。”唐逸看了一眼黑压压望不到头的人群，道：“你在这里找个位置躲一下，我得去救一下那家伙，免得发生意外……”大不了，就暴露诗仙的身份呗。“放心吧，前面有人帮他，不会有事。”这时，一道略显冰冷的声音传来。唐逸下意识将唐音护在身后，就看到站在前方的，是个铁塔一般的男人。是当日买诗的中年男人的护卫。男人看向唐逸，微微颔首道：“走吧，我家主人要见你，已经等了很久了。”唐逸知道中年男人的身份不简单，恐怕是朝中的某个大人物，不然《满江红》也不会引起这么大的轰动。他出手，那梁绍的安全应该没有问题了。“好，劳烦带路。”唐逸抱着唐音，跟在了赵虎身后。这时，一辆双辕青蓬马车正在唐逸对面缓缓驶来。马车车帘掀起半角，车中坐着的正是容颜倾城的孔诗岚，此时的她眉头微皱，看着唐逸的目光充满困惑。她来状元街，原本是来碰碰运气，看下能不能碰到那所谓的诗仙。她想邀请其参加沈园诗会，能写出《满江红》这种旷世诗词的人物，压制唐画应该没有问题。结果诗仙没有遇到，倒让她见到了唐逸兄妹。和当日她上门相比，唐逸和唐音的精气神好得太多了。看着两人站在状元街口纠结斗嘴的样子，说实话那一幕挺温馨的。只是接下来的一幕却让她大跌眼镜，总之不知道唐逸是不是为那被殴打的老乞丐出头，竟然逮住平远伯世子大叫诗仙！然后，整条街就乱套了。“十年寒窗无人问，一举成名天下知……”秋儿也在盯着唐逸，美眸很激动：“小姐，这是好诗耶，没想到小姐要找的诗仙，竟然被唐少爷给找出来了。”孔诗岚看了一眼秋儿，抬手在她的额头弹了一下：“蠢！”秋儿揉了揉额头，道：“小姐，难道诗仙不是唐少爷说的那个人？不会吧，可是那两句诗好有水平啊！”孔诗岚眉头微皱，是啊，这两句诗很有水平。十年寒窗无人问，一举成名天下知！可问题是这两句诗不可能出自梁绍之手，那家伙就是京都出了名的败家子，他懂得作诗才是见鬼！那就只能是出自唐逸。难道他就是诗仙？不可能吧？这家伙都没在学院结业，加上一直遭到颜霜玉的打压，恐怕连字都认不全……他会是诗仙？孔诗岚抬手揉了揉眉心，忽然觉得对唐逸还是缺少了解，需要重新调查一下了。只是等她从沉思中回过神，街上已经没有了唐逸的影子。……半刻钟后。唐逸跟着赵虎来到了状元街外的一家酒楼。进入房间，唐逸便看到包厢中除了当年买诗的中年男人，还有两个白发苍苍的老者。而除了当日买诗的中年男人外，那两个老者唐逸都认识。他连忙将唐音放下来，拱手道：“见过狄老将军，见过福王爷。”狄苍是大炎的大将军，可以说是大炎军界的定海神针，前身自幼那都是听着他的故事长大的，能不认识吗？至于福王，是先皇的哥哥，当今皇帝的伯父，年轻时也是风云人物，曾经以一张嘴，忽悠瘸了东虞的十万大军。可惜，哪怕有这两个风云人物在，大炎依旧没有躲过靖康耻。先帝，先皇后，都被北狄人凌辱致死！“小子，你就是那个小诗仙？好，诗写得好，帮了我们的大忙了！”狄苍竖起大拇指，对这个礼貌的小家伙当时就充满好感。唐逸微怔。老王爷见到他脸上的疑惑，笑着解释道：“你的一首《满江红》，坚定了陛下和北狄开战的意志，让早就磨刀霍霍的武将看到了希望。”原来是这样，难怪《满江红》能造成这么大的轰动。唐逸嘴角微微抽搐，那惨了，那那群文官不得恨死我啊！“见过狄爷爷，见过福王爷爷。”唐音跪在地上，直接磕头行礼。软糯糯的声音将狄苍和老王爷的思绪拉了过来，看到跪在地上精致的小女孩，心都快融化了。“好好好，好孩子，来，来爷爷这里。”狄苍立即向着向唐音伸出手。“滚开，就你那双刀一样的手，别伤到孩子。”福王打掉狄苍的手，慈祥看向唐音：“来，小家伙，来福王爷爷这里，爷爷这里有好吃的。”“怎么地？老东西，要打一架？”两个老者当场就争上了！
content_en: Tang Yi, your uncle, you wait for me!"Liang Shao yelled, broke away from Tang Yi and turned around to run away. "Young Master!"Damn it, what happened?"Why are all these people chasing the young master?"A group of guards were still beating the beggar who was huddled on the ground. When they saw people all over the street chasing their young master, they were all stunned. Shixian? The young master can't even recognize all the words, so how can he become a Shixian? "Shixian, don't run away, compose a poem for me!"Tang Yi was also chasing. He actually didn't want to chase him. When Liang Shao called out his name, he knew that he had misunderstood. But Tang Yin ran wildly in front of Liang Shao, forcing him to chase after her, otherwise the girl would be scattered by the crowd, and the consequences would be disastrous. This matter caused... a big misunderstanding! And from the memory of his predecessor, he knew that Liang Shao and his predecessor were good friends., but after the death of his mother, Yan Shuangyu came to power and wanted to support Tang Hua and prevent him from meeting Liang Shao and others.This resulted in Tang Yi and Liang Shao not seeing each other for almost four years.The young boy at that time had grown up, and the two did not recognize each other immediately, so there was a misunderstanding!"Liang Shao roared! Seeing the dark group of people behind him, he almost peed with fright and used all his strength to suck. "You are not Shixian, why are you running?!"Someone roared. "If you don't chase me, can I run away?Liang Shao responded directly. "Don't listen to his nonsense. He is the Immortal of Poetry. The child in front of him is the proof.""Someone pointed directly at Tang Yin and said loudly. As expected, everyone became even more excited when they saw Tang Yin. Yes, it is undoubtedly Shixian. That day, Shixian took a child and set up a stall to sell poems together. Bang! Tang Yi raised his hands to cover his face, brother, it's not that I don't explain, but now I can't explain it at all! Bad brother, you are going to kill Yin'er... Tang Yin ran at the front, and her big eyes were full of tears at this time. Her short legs, how could she outrun the long legs of an adult?Fortunately, after running halfway down the street, she saw a small alley and jumped into it.Liang Shao didn't know her identity, so he could only run forward, and a group of people also chased her from the alley.And the figure of his brother also appeared at the entrance of the alley, holding his hands on his knees, pretending to be breathing heavily, "Brother, that's Brother Liang, is he...will he be okay?""Tang Yin knew Liang Shao. Before her brother was grounded, Liang Shao brought people to see him several times. He also brought her a lot of delicious food, but they were all snatched by his second brother. "It should, maybe, probably, maybe... it will be okay.Tang Yi glanced at the dark crowd with no end in sight, and said: "You find a place to hide here. I have to save that guy to avoid an accident..." The worst case scenario is that Shixian's identity will be revealed. "Don't worry, there is someone in front of you to help him, and everything will be fine.""At this time, a slightly cold voice came. Tang Yi subconsciously protected Tang Yin behind him, and saw a man standing in front of him like an iron tower. He was the guard of the middle-aged man who bought poems that day. The man looked at Tang Yi, nodded slightly and said: "Let's go, my master wants to see you, and has been waiting for a long time."Tang Yi knew that the identity of the middle-aged man was not simple. He was probably a big shot in the court, otherwise "Man Jiang Hong" would not have caused such a big sensation. If he took action, there should be no problem with Liang Shao's safety. "Okay, please lead the way."Tang Yi hugged Tang Yin and followed Zhao Hu. At this time, a double-column green-covered carriage was slowly driving across from Tang Yi. The curtain of the carriage was raised halfway, and the person sitting in the carriage was the stunning Kong Shilan. At this time, she frowned slightly, looking at Tang Yi with confusion in her eyes. She came to Zhuangyuan StreetShe originally came to try her luck and see if she could meet the so-called Poetry Fair.She wanted to invite him to participate in the Shen Yuan Poetry Society. Someone who could write a masterpiece like "Man Jiang Hong" should have no problem suppressing Tang Hua.As a result, she didn't meet the Poet Fairy, but she met Tang Yi and her brother that day.Compared to going to the door, Tang Yi and Tang Yin were in much better spirits.Seeing the two of them arguing and arguing at the entrance of Zhuangyuan Street, the scene was quite heartwarming, but the next scene surprised her.In short, she didn't know if Tang Yi stood up for the beaten old beggar.He caught Prince Pingyuan and shouted Shixian!Then, the whole street was in chaos."No one asked about it in ten years, and he became famous all over the world..." Qiu'er was also staring at Tang Yi, her beautiful eyes were very excited: "Miss, this is a good poem. I didn't expect that the Shixian I was looking for was found by Master Tang."Kong Shilan glanced at Qiu'er, raised her hand and flicked her forehead: "Stupid!"Qiu'er rubbed her forehead and said, "Miss, isn't Shixian the person that Master Tang said?"No, but those two lines of poetry are so good!"Kong Shilan frowned slightly. Yes, these two lines of poetry are very good. No one asked him about it for ten years, and he became famous all over the world! But the problem is that these two lines of poetry cannot be written by Liang Shao. That guy is a famous prodigal son in Kyoto. He knows how to write poetry.!Then it can only be from Tang Yi.Is it possible that he is Shixian?This guy has never graduated from the academy, and he has been suppressed by Yan Shuangyu.I am afraid he can't even recognize the word... Kong Shilan raised his hand and rubbed his eyebrows.Tang Yi still lacked understanding and needed to investigate again.But when she came back from her thoughts, there was no trace of Tang Yi on the street... Half a quarter of an hour later, Tang Yi followed Zhao Hu to a restaurant outside Zhuangyuan Street and saw Tang Yi.In addition to the middle-aged man who bought the poem, there were two gray-haired old men in the box.In addition to the middle-aged man who bought the poem, Tang Yi knew the two old men.He quickly put Tang Yin down and said, "I have seen General Di and Prince Fu."Di Cang is the great general of Dayan, and can be said to be the Dinghai Shenzhen of Dayan's military world. I have grown up listening to his stories since childhood. How can I not recognize him? As for King Fu, he is the elder brother of the late emperor and the uncle of the current emperor. He was also a man of great influence when he was young., once deceived Dongyu's 100,000-strong army.Unfortunately, even with these two influential figures, Dayan still did not escape the shame of Jingkang."Boy, are you that little poetry fairy?"Well, the poem is well written and it has helped us a lot!Di Cang gave a thumbs up and was full of affection for this polite little guy. Tang Yi was slightly startled. The old prince saw him.
title_en: Chapter 18 This is a big misunderstanding!
